headline: Pick of the Day (short-term delivery call)

highlights: Asset light strategy to support growth: Over the last 6 years, IHL has moved to an asset-light business model to achieve scalable growth while optimizing capital allocation.
Moreover, management fee income has grown 30% YoY during 1HFY27.
Healthy room inventory pipeline till 2031: IHL has a robust growth pipeline of 87 hotels with ~8,940 keys spread across all segments of Indian hospitality sector.
Strong 2QFY27 result performance: IHL reported strong set of numbers in 2QFY27 with Revenue/EBITDA/PAT growth of 25.6%/37.0%/52.6% YoY respectively.
valuation: Delivery Vol. in lakh (5 days/30 days) 22.0 / 18.5 Promoter Holding (%) 39.8 Pledge (%) - CMP (Rs) 173.0 Accumulation Range (Rs) 171 – 175 Target (Rs) 191.0 Upside Potential (%) 10.4% Duration 6-12 Months Source: ACE Equity, SSL Research ITC Hotels Ltd.
The company targets to grow its portfolio to 250 hotels with 22,000+ keys by 2031.

Attractive valuation: At CMP of Rs 173, the stock trades at FY27E/FY28E Bloomberg consensus EV/EBITDA of 20.7x/17.8x respectively which looks attractive given its strong brand, healthy room pipeline and increasing asset-light model.
watch: Today, IHL is one of the largest hotel companies with 156 hotels across ~90 destinations comprising of 14,300+ operating keys.
The company targets to grow its portfolio to 250 hotels with 22,000+ keys by 2031.
